scope: Issue #143 Phase 1 (H1-H4 Harness settings, B1 public command input). Twelve temporary production mutations - at least one per Harness, both the creation and the Thread-update path for Codex and OpenCode (Codex also covers the accepted creation branch), three at the command boundary (the settings shell, the Bart directory-tag normalization in the shared contract, and the router absolute-path guard) - detected, minimized, replayed and restored; no production defect discovered or shipped. The whole sweep was re-run against the exact revision of the two property files recorded in propertySha256, so every recorded detection belongs to the tests as delivered.
